info.name: Job Board API
info.description:
Requests for the SQL/PostgreSQL learning job board API.

Every controller ships with an empty pool.query(``) — the SQL is the exercise. Until a query is written, its endpoint returns an empty result or the controller's own guard (404 / 409), not an error. Use these requests to check each query as you write it.

Disabled query parameters are the optional filters; enable the ones you want to test.

body.raw:
{
  "company_id": "{{companyId}}",
  "title": "Staff Backend Engineer",
  "description": "Own the data model.",
  "salary_min": 150000,
  "salary_max": 190000,
  "location": "Remote",
  "is_remote": true,
  "employment_type": "full_time",
  "experience_level": "lead"
}
